priorityList: Maintain Virulent Plague with Outbreak if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining.
Cast Army of the Dead whenever available.
Cast Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead is active or if its cooldown is greater than 30 seconds.
Cast Death and Decay (Desecrate) if it is not already ticking on the ground.
Use Festering Strike if the Festering Scythe buff or debuff is about to expire.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health.
Use Scourge Strike if you have at least 1 stack of Lesser Ghoul Ready to summon a Rider of the Apocalypse.
Cast Epidemic to spend Runic Power when you have Sudden Doom procs or fewer than 2 Runes (priority at 4+ enemies).
Cast Death Coil to spend Runic Power when you have Sudden Doom procs or fewer than 2 Runes (priority at 1-3 enemies).
Cast Putrefy if it is at max charges or if Dark Transformation is on cooldown.
Use Festering Strike to generate resources if you have 0 stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready.
Cast Epidemic as your primary Runic Power spender if there are 4+ enemies.
Cast Death Coil as your Runic Power spender if there are fewer than 4 enemies.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials during Dark Transformation or while Riders are active.
